topic: Goose: Open Source Extensible AI Agent Beyond Code Suggestions

key_points: Block (Square, Cash App) open-sourced Goose in early 2025
~60% of Block's 12,000 employees use Goose weekly, ~4,000 actively across 15 job profiles
Key innovation is the 'recipe' system — reproducible, version-controlled workflows
Recipes are YAML files with numbered steps that Goose treats as a planning skeleton
MCP extension system lets Goose inherit the entire MCP ecosystem
Goose installs nothing globally — runs locally with user's LLM credentials
Recommended LLM: Claude Sonnet 4-5 (same as internal Block users)
52,453+ GitHub stars, 5,927 forks
Built in Rust (69%) with TypeScript (26%)
Apache 2.0 license
Topics: acp, ai, ai-agents, mcp
Active development — v1.45.0 released July 29, 2026
Top contributors: DOsinga, alexhancock, zanesq, jamadeo, michaelneale
Desktop app for macOS, Linux, Windows + full CLI + API
Works with 15+ LLM providers: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure, Bedrock
70+ extensions via MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Part of Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) at Linux Foundation since April 2026
Features: Recipe system, Hooks, Mesh LLM routing, Peekaboo (desktop control), built-in local inference
Goose integrates with Docker Model Runner for local AI agent deployment
Can run entirely in containers with ttyd for browser-based terminal access
Docker MCP Gateway provides tools for the agent
Supports local models like Qwen3 via Docker Model Runner
Goose moved from Block to Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under Linux Foundation in April 2026
AAIF also hosts MCP and Agents.md — governance is now multi-company
Ensures long-term neutrality and community-driven development
Block remains a major contributor but no longer sole steward

angles: Goose is unique among AI coding agents because it's not just for developers — Block saw adoption across sales, design, product, and customer success roles
The 'recipe' system is the killer feature: YAML-based, version-controlled, reproducible workflows that turn ad-hoc agent sessions into engineering artifacts
MCP-first architecture means Goose benefits from the entire MCP ecosystem without building proprietary integrations
Move to AAIF/Linux Foundation signals maturation of the open-source AI agent space and ensures vendor neutrality
Goose vs Claude Code vs GitHub Copilot vs Codex: Goose is the only one that's fully open-source, provider-agnostic, and extends beyond code to general automation
Rust-based performance makes it lightweight compared to Electron-based alternatives
The 'beyond code' positioning is real — Goose handles research, writing, automation, data analysis, and workflow orchestration
